explanation: The payments-api Service selects release=blue despite two healthy release=stable backends. Even after restoring EndpointSlices, checkout-egress points at a legacy non-existent payments security-zone and payments-ingress trusts an obsolete storefront zone. Because network policies enforce source egress AND destination ingress, all three independent repairs are required. Historical database timeouts are unrelated.
validation: Verify ready EndpointSlice backends, authorized gateway request success on Service port 8443, direct TCP/8080 policy enforcement, audit port 9090 and DNS continuity, and denial for debug and sandbox sources.
